card.name: Linking words before mycobacteria names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (was, to, by, as, other) right before a mycobacteria or rifamycin name, in tuberculosis and NTM text. Also fires on a leading digit in section numbers and years in the same setting.

modes.label: Link before organism or drug
modes.description: A short word such as was, to, by, as or other sits just before Mycobacterium avium complex, rifamycins or similar names.
modes.example: The most frequently isolated NTM<< was>> Mycobacterium avium complex.

modes.label: Leading digit of a number
modes.description: The first digit of a year or section reference in mycobacterial label text.

card.writes: Pushes odd word-start pieces such as 'str' and 'umer' and suppresses unrelated tokens, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on small joining words just before the name of a TB-type germ or rifamycin drug.
